descriptions.base: Tokens, paper stocks, pens, frames, the appearance runtime, FinelinerDefs, cn and the pen's seed and filters. Every other item builds on it; make src/fineliner/styles/fineliner.css your Tailwind entry.
descriptions.pen: The pen engine, framework-free: seeded strokes, shapes and sheets, the object library with every collection, scenes, lettering and pen marks, as SVG strings on a server, at build time or in the browser.
descriptions.drawing: Drawing, Lettering and PenMark: objects, scenes, words and marks drawn by the pen from their seeds as inline SVG, with line boil and draw-on.
descriptions.fineliner: Every part of Fineliner: the base, the pen engine and every component. Blocks are sample pages, so they install one at a time.
descriptions.chart: Recharts drawn with the page's one pen: drawnBar, drawnCurve, drawnDot and drawnSector draw strokes through the exact data points, and series are told apart by solid, outline, dotted and lined marks rather than colour.
descriptions.use-highlighted-code: useHighlightedCode: Shiki loaded lazily, one grammar at a time, with tokens mapped to one pen (bold keywords, italic strings, quiet comments) for CodeBlock.
